properties.description: Fires when Owner, Contributor or User Access Administrator is successfully assigned in Azure. Role is parsed from the Start event and joined to the Success event. Handles camelCase (Policy/ARM) and PascalCase (portal) request bodies.
properties.query:
let PrivilegedRoles = datatable(RoleGuid:string, RoleName:string, AlertSeverity:string) [
    "8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635", "Owner", "High",
    "18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9", "User Access Administrator", "High",
    "f58310d9-a9f6-439a-9e8d-f62e7b41a168", "Role Based Access Control Administrator", "High",
    "b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c", "Contributor", "Medium"
];
let Started = AzureActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where OperationNameValue =~ "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE"
    | where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Start"
    | extend Req = parse_json(tostring(Properties_d.requestbody))
    | extend RoleDefId = coalesce(tostring(Req.properties.roleDefinitionId),
                                  tostring(Req.Properties.RoleDefinitionId)),
             PrincipalType = coalesce(tostring(Req.properties.principalType),
                                      tostring(Req.Properties.PrincipalType)),
             Entity = tostring(Properties_d.entity)
    | extend RoleGuid = tostring(split(RoleDefId, "/")[-1])
    | project CorrelationId, Entity, RoleGuid, PrincipalType;
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ingestion_time() > ago(15m)
| where OperationNameValue =~ "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| extend Entity = tostring(Properties_d.entity)
| join kind=inner Started on CorrelationId, Entity
| join kind=inner PrivilegedRoles on RoleGuid
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, RoleName, PrincipalType, ResourceGroup, AlertSeverity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Caller}} assigned {{RoleName}} in {{ResourceGroup}}. Check custom details for principal type.
